RFC 7296 Section 2.21.4: 'The response MUST NOT be cryptographically protected and MUST contain an INVALID_IKE_SPI Notify payload.' TestNtfOutOfSAAnswersWithInvalidIKESPI parses the answer and requires exactly one payload, a Notify of type INVALID_IKE_SPI with an empty SPI and no data, so a wrong type, a missing Notify, an extra payload or an SK payload fails; the fixture behind ipsec-error-notify-no-loop.ci requires the body after the header to be one 4-octet Notify of type 4 (INVALID_IKE_SPI) with next payload 0 through the real UDP path. The negatives (an IKE_SA_INIT to an unknown SPI draws nothing) are controls on the emitter's guard rather than violating inputs. No discrimination record.
